input.summary: Customer owns and Vendor assigns Deliverables; Vendor's Customer Data rights narrowed to processing solely to provide the Services
input.comment: [Playbook] We own the work product we pay for, so we have flipped Section 14.2 to Customer ownership with an express assignment (Vendor keeps Vendor Technology under 14.3 and the embedded-IP licence in 13.2 is unchanged). We also narrowed Vendor's Customer Data rights in 14.1 and 15.1 to processing solely to provide the Services, removing the improvement and consent-based uses.

ops.oldText: 14.2 Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: 14.2 Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable and work product created for Customer, and Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all right, title, and interest in each Deliverable and work product.

ops.oldText: solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer
ops.newText: solely to provide the Services for Customer

ops.oldText: only on Customer's documented instructions, to provide the Services, and as permitted by this Agreement. Vendor shall not sell Customer Data, use it for advertising, combine it with another customer's identifiable data, or train a generally available model on it without Customer's express written consent.
ops.newText: solely to provide the Services and on Customer's documented instructions. Vendor shall not sell Customer Data, use it for advertising, combine it with another customer's identifiable data, or train a generally available model on it.
